name: Foundation
objective: Materialize governed source evidence, canonical/PIT state, feature lifecycle, team state and strong reproducible baseline capability.
entry_gate: W06 replan cleared; W07 identity contracts frozen
exit_gate: PIT-safe national foundation and baseline evidence are implementable/replayable; source-dependent assumptions revalidated.

name: Advanced Football Intelligence
objective: Add player, roster, availability, transfers, coaching, context and game-mechanics intelligence with uncertainty-aware missingness.
entry_gate: PHASE-1 canonical/PIT contracts stable enough for advanced states
exit_gate: Advanced football state contracts are PIT-safe and can be ablated against foundation baselines.

name: Texas A&M Specialization
objective: Create disproportionately high-resolution A&M state, specialization, calibration, BAS science and A&M-specific evaluation without replacing national truth.
exit_gate: A&M specialization and BAS are scientifically specified, leakage-safe and independently evaluable.

name: Production & Autonomy
objective: Make selected models/evaluation/research/weekly orchestration/product/operations reproducible, governed and locally operable.
entry_gate: Model/validation contracts and starter implementation available
exit_gate: End-to-end pregame forecasts can be regenerated, monitored, served and governed through immutable snapshots.

name: Advanced Research & Finalization
objective: Provide gated challenger/live research, full replay/readiness challenge and final Codex handoff without destabilizing proven baselines.
entry_gate: Strong simple baselines and protected evaluation framework exist
exit_gate: W24 readiness/architecture challenge complete and W25 canonical handoff is internally consistent.
